name: Zoom Clinical Notes
one_liner: AI-powered clinical documentation built into Zoom's HIPAA-compliant healthcare platform with 100+ specialty templates.
short_description: Zoom Clinical Notes is an AI scribe integrated into Zoom for Healthcare, generating clinical documentation from both telehealth and in-person visits in under 60 seconds.
long_description: Zoom Clinical Notes (also called Zoom AI Scribe) is an AI-powered clinical documentation tool built into Zoom's healthcare platform. The system captures patient encounters during telehealth video visits or in-person appointments via mobile device, then generates clinical note drafts in under 60 seconds. It includes customizable templates for over 100 medical specialties, ICD-10 code suggestions for billing accuracy, and AI-generated patient instructions and referral letters. The Chrome extension allows clinicians to view notes in a side panel and copy directly into any browser-based EHR with smart field targeting. Built on Zoom's HIPAA-compliant infrastructure with BAA available, it's designed for healthcare organizations already using Zoom for telehealth.
best_for: Healthcare organizations already using Zoom for telehealth
Clinicians wanting seamless documentation within their video platform
not_for: Solo practitioners seeking budget-friendly standalone AI scribe
Clinicians wanting deep native EHR integration (uses copy-paste)

faqs.q: How much does Zoom Clinical Notes cost?
faqs.a: Zoom Clinical Notes pricing is not publicly disclosed and requires a custom enterprise quote. It's an add-on to Zoom Workplace for Clinicians. Industry average for AI scribes is $150-200/provider/month.

faqs.q: Does Zoom Clinical Notes work with my EHR?
faqs.a: Zoom Clinical Notes works with any browser-based EHR via its Chrome extension, which copies notes with smart field targeting. It doesn't offer deep native EHR integrations but supports copy-paste workflows.

faqs.q: Can I use Zoom Clinical Notes for in-person visits?
faqs.a: Yes, Zoom Clinical Notes supports both telehealth (Zoom video meetings) and in-person visits via mobile device. The AI captures the conversation and generates clinical notes either way.

faqs.q: Is Zoom Clinical Notes HIPAA compliant?
faqs.a: Yes, Zoom Clinical Notes is built on Zoom's HIPAA-compliant healthcare infrastructure and offers a Business Associate Agreement (BAA) for covered entities. It has SOC 2 Type II certification.
